descriptionChirho: Something morally or ritually abhorrent, used in the singular (absolute or construct) to denote a detestable act, practice, or object — often predicated of specific behaviors as offensive to God or to right order.

Plural form referring to multiple abominable acts or idolatrous practices collectively — used absolutely, in construct, or with pronominal suffixes to catalog the detestable deeds of nations, cities, or individuals.
